work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CX confirms the patrician order of Veroli and its right to the chief magistracy; LF20926 → LF20935 across own provenance LF20929 and page number 142 LF20932; complete 13 September 1836 closing (no derogation clause is printed). Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF20872–20872; the source closing at LF20992–20995 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam sub annulo piscatoris die decima tertia septembris miille- simo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pontifi- catus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
